lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots (~5-12 pixels in diameter) organized in a semi-regular grid on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance spots to create a lattice-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges extending along the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from bright dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs localized within the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin near the water surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated high-luminance biological feature (likely a remora) positioned at the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin.
